findings.message: Large whitespace padding was detected (a block of blank lines or a long run of spaces). This can push injected instructions below or to the right of the visible area so a human reviewer never sees them while the agent still reads them. Manual review of the hidden content is recommended.
findings.remediation: Remove the large whitespace padding (blank-line blocks or long space runs) and review any content hidden below or to the right of it. Keep skill files compact and reviewable so no instructions can be concealed off-screen.

findings.code_snippet:
## Judging the result

Do not judge a texture by looking at the tile. Judge it tiled. Check the four edges continue into
each other, then check a 3x3 repeat for a motif that has become a pattern. A tile that looks
excellent alone and shows an obvious rhythm at 3x3 is a failed tile.
findings.message: Skill instructs the agent to omit warnings, disclaimers, or ethical commentary. Stripping safety caveats hides risk from the user and is a common jailbreak preamble.
findings.remediation: Remove instructions that suppress warnings, disclaimers, or ethical commentary. Let the agent surface safety-relevant caveats to the user.

- Using `text_to_video` when an approved still already exists.
- Leaving the camera unspecified, then fighting drift the model added by default.
- Planning a long piece as one clip without checking a model's duration limit.
- Assuming audio can be added later on a model that could have generated it natively.
- Prompting for a loop instead of filtering for the `loop` capability, or leaving `fixed_duration`
  off when the length matters.
